parameters.description: The environment deployed to, such as production.
parameters.name: environment

parameters.description: The revision deployed, usually a Git SHA.
parameters.name: revision

parameters.description: How the deploy went. Rollbar uses succeeded if left blank.
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: A note to show with the deploy.
parameters.name: comment

parameters.description: The Rollbar username of whoever deployed.
parameters.name: rollbar_username

parameters.description: The name of whoever deployed, shown when there's no Rollbar username.

report_item.description: Send an error or message to Rollbar from a workflow. Rollbar groups it into an item, as it does what your code reports, and alerts your team as the project's notifications say. Returns the occurrence's UUID; 'Find the item for a reported occurrence' looks up the item once Rollbar has processed it, usually within a few seconds.
report_item.name: report_item

parameters.description: Where it happened, such as production or staging. Rollbar adds a new environment the first time it sees its name.
parameters.name: environment

parameters.description: The text to report.
parameters.name: message

parameters.description: How severe it is. Rollbar uses info if left blank.
parameters.name: level

parameters.description: The item's title, up to 255 characters. Rollbar makes one from the message if left blank.
parameters.name: title

parameters.description: Extra details to keep with it, such as an order number or a customer ID.
parameters.name: custom

schema.description: Extra details to keep with it, such as an order number or a customer ID.

parameters.description: The version of your code, up to 40 characters: a Git SHA, a semantic version or a build number.
parameters.name: code_version

parameters.description: Which part of your app it came from, such as checkout#submit.
parameters.name: context

parameters.description: Reports with the same fingerprint are grouped into one item. Rollbar decides the grouping if left blank.
parameters.name: fingerprint

report_item.result_str_template: Report an error or message completed.

uuid.description: The UUID of the occurrence Rollbar received.

rollbar_new_deploy_trigger.description: Runs for each new deploy in Rollbar. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, project_id, environment, revision, status, comment, local_username, user_id, start_time, finish_time

rollbar_new_item_trigger.description: Runs for each new item in Rollbar. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, counter, project_id, title, level, status, environment, platform, framework, hash, total_occurrences, first_occurrence_id, first_occurrence_timestamp, last_occurrence_id, last_occurrence_timestamp, last_activated_timestamp, last_resolved_timestamp, resolved_in_version, assigned_user_id, assigned_team_id, group_item_id
